fundamental.summary: CDW shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signals, zero government contract activity, no lobbying engagement, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 75 days present material risk with no offsetting fundamental catalysts.

sentiment.summary: No actionable congressional signal; mixed retail sentiment (bearish 37% vs bullish 33%) with neutral fear/greed (48) and absent news data provide insufficient conviction for directional bias.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (338.56) indicates extreme market stress, and earnings in 75 days adds event risk to an already hostile environment.

debate.key_bull_argument: Hull flip, 15x volume spike, and 20-day new high create genuine bullish structure with technical momentum despite overbought conditions.
debate.key_bear_argument: Extreme overbought oscillators (RSI-9 70.09, Stoch-K 94.89), failed 50/200 EMA bullish alignment, zero fundamental catalysts, and crisis-level macro headwinds (inverted yield curve, VIX 338.56) create unacceptable pullback risk into earnings in 75 days.
